newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise four bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon weekly CDs raise four bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued certificates of deposit dated September 6 to commercial banks worth four billion Lebanese pounds compared with 10 billion pounds last week.
The bank sold 60-day CDs worth four billion compared with five billion last week. There were no sales of 45-day CDs this week compared with five billion last week.
Interest rates on the 45- and 60-day CDs were 12.75 precent and 13.50 percent respectively, down from 13 percent and 13.75 percent.
